provenance_notes: 5-layer ensemble probe bundle for Phase 0.9 R3 (Action 1 multi-layer ensemble reward). Probes were originally fit per-layer on n=600 VLBias disambig records by phase08_layer_probe (probe_layers.py P3 logistic regression). Per-layer μ/σ computed offline on the SB-Bench-9axis HS cache to match the PPO training distribution; the trainer's reward computation will apply z-normalisation as z_L = (proj_L - μ_L) / σ_L, then pool by mean over the 5 layers, then negate (consistent with bias_aligned reward sign convention).
